body:
APPROVE — exact NFRD v3 review of cand-2KZH2JA107QCVY6KMP7ZM3G4R4 at 7c7858f3c6aac5277bb34e905b532828d22da1a2.

The blocked receipt-identity premise is repaired:
- DiagnosticOriginSpec checks root/reason once, constructs the exact Origin.Diagnostic returned by the verifier, and supplies NUL-framed canonical parts plus its independent digest to input-receipt/v3.
- artifactReferenceSummary binds every typed fixed and participant reference as a sorted (kind, full subject identity, checked relative path) triple. Participant subjects use the full ParticipantKey checksum. Only count and aggregate checksum render; no path, filename, or participant token does.
- the complete receipt binds both origin and artifact-reference summaries; the six declared paths are exact and diff-check clean; public construction refusals remain.

Independent exact archive evidence:
- NfrdBaseballSuite 21/21 and NfrdIntakePublicSuite 4/4 passed.
- Removing only origin.canonicalParts plus origin.checksum from the aggregate address made the root/reason mutation court fail at the expected contentChecksum inequality (20 passed, 1 failed).
- Restoring origin and removing only artifactReference count/checksum from the aggregate address made the fixed-artifact relocation court fail at the expected contentChecksum inequality (20 passed, 1 failed).

The tests independently recompute both new digests with JVM SHA-256 framing, and relocation keeps bytes/checksums equal while changing only the retained reference. This closes my formal 337600b block. Required external/gate evidence and the second reviewer remain separate.
